name: Synthesis of Co(ttpp)
plain_text_description:
References and modifications
AD-R18 (77% yield)
Analysis results
NMR M1: matched AD-R18-M1
NMR M2: bad shim → because of Co precipitate
NMR P: Co(ttpp). Some Co(III) → because of CDCl3 or impurity
Obtained products or insights
Better yield

Procedure
RT 21.9 °C, RH 38%
Reaction
100 mL two-neck RBF with a stir bar, septum (natural rubber), reflux condenser, T-shaped connector, bubbler (with paraffin oil), Schlenk line (N₂, 1.25 atm), heat gun, magnetic stirrer, oil bath
Heat the flask in an oven at 120 °C for >1.5 h
Quickly assemble and evacuate the system while it is still hot (5.7 × 10⁻³ mbar)
Heat the flask and the bottom part of the reflux condenser with a heat gun (250 °C)
Close the N₂ connection. Add TAPP and TrBr (plastic spatula) quickly
Cycle with N₂ slowly ×3
Add NEt₃
Add THF → dark green liquid
Start stirring (350 rpm) [9:30]
Cover the flask with aluminum foil
Let it stir for 1 h
→ 0.1 mL + 400 µL of CDCl₃ → ¹H NMR M1 (U1.834; N PROTON20ppm; O1P: 6, SW: 22)
Stop stirring. Close the N₂ connection. Add CoCl₂ quickly. Purge with N₂ for 10 s. Close. Resume stirring. 
Bubble with N₂ for 30 min [11:00]
Heat to reflux (85 °C, oil bath) for 2 h [13:30] 
Cool down to RT
→ 0.1 mL + 400 µL of CDCl₃ → ¹H NMR M2 (U1.834; N PROTON20ppm; O1P 6, SW 22) [syringe filter should be used]
plain_text_observation:
Short-pad chromatography
Fritted funnel (50mL, por. 4), suction adapter, 100 mL RBF, T-connector, diaphragm pump
Add 15 g of neutral alumina
Add THF to fully wet the alumina
Add the reaction mixture
Elute with suction and THF until the eluate becomes pale red → 70 mL, alumina pad (Green at the top, off white at the bottom)
Rotovap
Dry under vacuum Schlenk line, 1 h 
Dark brown solid

RT 21.9 °C, RH 32 %
CHCl₃ deacidification
250 mL RBF
Add basic alumina 20 g
Add CHCl₃ 150 mL and swirl
Fritted funnel (50 mL, por. 4), suction adapter, 250 mL RBF, diaphragm pump
Filter the mixture under suction

Reprecipitation
Add 30 mL of purified CHCl₃ to the flask and sonicate → dark red solution
Add 180 mL of n-hexane, swirl, sonicate
Store in fridge (0 °C) for 1 h
Fritted funnel (50 mL, por. 4), suction adapter, 500 mL RBF, diaphragm pump 
Filter the mixture under suction → faint brown filtrate
Rinse w/ 2 x (10 mL of purified CHCl₃ + 60 mL of hexane)
Rinse with 2 × 30 mL of petroleum ether [hexane should be used]
Dry under vacuum (desiccator, diaphragm pump, overnight) → reddish brown solid

Analysis
RT 20.4 °C, RH 45%
20 mL vial with PTFE sealing (tare: 15.52848 g)
Weigh : 575.90 g
→ 1H NMR P (CDCl₃; U1.834; N PROTON 20 ppm; O1P 6, SW 22) (dark red solution)  [should be measured in DMSO as well]
Store in the fridge
